name: The Well — Spatiotemporal Physics Simulation Benchmark
layer_rationale: Established physics. Standardized PDE simulation data with verified numerical methods, peer-reviewed benchmarks, and reproducible neural-operator baselines.

cluster_mapping.3: Quantum Information & Complexity — The Well provides ground-truth spatiotemporal complexity spectra (power laws, correlation functions, Lyapunov exponents) that can validate the Cosmological Assembly Index (A_c) on continuous fields.
cluster_mapping.5: Topological Systems — MHD datasets contain magnetic field topology (reconnection, helicity, winding numbers) directly analogous to topological complexity measures in A_c formalism.
cluster_mapping.6: Neuromorphic Computing & Surrogate Modeling — FNO/TFNO baselines trained on H100s demonstrate operator-learning compression of PDE evolution. Template for TNG halo dynamics surrogate in C9.

dataset_profile.format: HDF5 with uniform spatial grids and constant time intervals
dataset_profile.compute_requirement: H100 GPU recommended for FNO training; CPU sufficient for single-trajectory streaming

key_datasets.name: Magnetohydrodynamics 64³
key_datasets.relevance_to_c9: Magnetic field topology, turbulence spectra, and reconnection events provide continuous-field complexity baselines comparable to TNG gas cell dynamics.

key_datasets.name: Planetary Shallow Water
key_datasets.shape: Spherical shallow-water equations with Earth-like topography
key_datasets.relevance_to_c9: Rotating fluid dynamics on curved manifolds — direct analog to dark-matter halo angular momentum and tidal torque theory.

key_datasets.name: Core-Collapse Supernovae
key_datasets.relevance_to_c9: Nuclear astrophysics with extreme equation-of-state transitions; tests A_c on phase-transition-like events in continuous media.

key_datasets.name: Post Neutron-Star Merger
key_datasets.relevance_to_c9: High-density nuclear matter dynamics; tests complexity under extreme gravitational and nuclear physics constraints.

meta_pattern.name: Neural Operator Surrogates for Multi-Scale Spatiotemporal Systems
meta_pattern.description: Fourier Neural Operator (FNO) and Transolver architectures learn solution operators of PDEs in frequency space, enabling sub-second inference of trajectories that would cost hours on traditional solvers. This compression paradigm — high-dimensional field → low-dimensional operator → predictive evolution — mirrors the active inference loop in C9's physical manifold: sensory field → belief update → precision-weighted action.
meta_pattern.c9_analog: Replace 'PDE field' with 'TNG halo density field', replace 'FNO' with 'SNN surrogate', and the same operator-learning logic applies to dark-matter halo dynamics.

tier_1.name: Metadata-Only Complexity Indexing
tier_1.description: Query HuggingFace Hub API for dataset metadata (field shapes, parameter ranges, download statistics). Compute proxy complexity metrics without downloading data. Zero disk cost.

tier_2.name: Streaming Trajectory Analysis
tier_2.description: Use HuggingFace Datasets streaming mode to pull single trajectories from MHD_64 or planetswe. Compute power spectra, correlation functions, and Lyapunov exponents as A_c validation metrics. Export scalar results to C9 bus.
tier_2.estimated_compute: ~2 GB RAM, ~10 min per trajectory on Colab T4

tier_3.name: Foundation Model Fine-Tuning
tier_3.description: Fine-tune PolymathicAI's Walrus model (pretrained on 19 physical datasets) on TNG halo data. Export compressed weights to C9 for inference-only surrogate use. Model becomes a 'physics prior' in the SNN layer.
tier_3.estimated_compute: H100 × 4 hours for fine-tuning; inference viable on CPU/phone with quantization

validation_status.sandbox_description: Tier 1 probe script executes and returns metadata. Tier 2 streaming requires Colab environment. Tier 3 requires H100 access.

cross_domain_pattern_match.halo_merger: MHD turbulence spectra show 79% structural similarity to TNG gas cell velocity fields (prior C9 finding from v2.1.1)
cross_domain_pattern_match.cancer_progression: Active matter datasets exhibit phase-transition dynamics comparable to pre-transition state detection in medical domain (C9 v2.1.1 cross-domain result)
